extra.floor_runs: repeat: a second process at 4 threads; threads1: one process at 1 thread; ulp: 4 threads with every atom coordinate nudged one ulp up (WPX_ULP=1)

notes.BasisGradient.evaluate: (function, axis, point) complex; perturbed: points moved by 0.01 Bohr in x. Rows 44 and 45 are the two nuclei, 46 is 1e-13 Bohr away (nucleus branch), 47 is beyond every cutoff (zero)
notes.radial_slope: (function, r); perturbed: r scaled by 1+1e-6 (rows are the basis functions in crystal order)
notes.short_range_cross.even_odd.atom0: (k, even rows, odd cols); perturbed: every k shifted by 0.01 Bohr^-1 along (1,1,1)
notes.short_range_cross.even_odd.atom1: (k, even rows, odd cols); perturbed: every k shifted by 0.01 Bohr^-1 along (1,1,1)
notes.remainder_transforms.atom0: (a, b, vector) complex; perturbed: the atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr (a phase exp(-i g.d))
notes.remainder_transforms.atom1: (a, b, vector) complex; perturbed: the atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr (a phase exp(-i g.d))
notes.onsite_remainder.atom0: (a, b, c, d) Hartree; perturbed: indices (a,c,b,d) (a wrong pair convention)
notes.onsite_remainder.atom1: (a, b, c, d) Hartree; perturbed: indices (a,c,b,d) (a wrong pair convention)
notes.projector_lm: (P, 4): atom, l, m, radial index of every projector in crystal order (T0 exact)
notes.ion_constants_gradient: (atom, axis) Ha/Bohr; perturbed: the last atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr
notes.ion_constants: Ha, the sum whose derivative is frozen; perturbed: the last atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr
notes.short_range_ion_compensation_gradient: (channel, atom, axis) complex per Bohr, channels sorted as in inputs.sr_channels; perturbed as above
notes.short_range_ion_compensation: (channel) complex, the sum whose derivative is frozen; perturbed as ion_constants
notes.local_potential_derivative: Ha/Bohr, dataset 0 (the slope short_range_potential_derivative is built from); perturbed: r scaled by 1+1e-6

BasisGradient.fd_abs.note: central difference of parent.evaluate, step 1e-05 Bohr, 1116 points away from the nucleus

BasisGradient.nucleus_p0_analytic.note: d_z(R'(0) r Y_10) = R'(0) sqrt(3/4pi) at the nucleus

BasisGradient.s_nucleus_max.note: an s function has no gradient at its own nucleus

radial_slope.fd_abs.note: central difference of function.radial, step 1e-06 Bohr, breakpoints excluded

short_range_cross.im_over_max.atom0.note: non-vacuity: the generic k makes the array complex (a wrong k.R sign changes it)

short_range_cross.translation_fd_abs.ato.note: -(G + G^H) against the central difference (step 0.0001 Bohr) of the matrix with every basis center shifted and the sphere fixed

remainder_transforms.hermitian.atom0.note: E_ab(g) = conj(E_ba(-g)); the gate of test_it_is_hermitian_in_the_pair

remainder_transforms.g0_over_max.atom0.note: the remainder carries no net charge: E(0) is small against the rest

remainder_transforms.table_step_error.note: relative to the maximum: step 0.025 against a table four times finer (interpolation error)

onsite_remainder.pair_exchange.atom0.note: pair-exchange asymmetry, relative; a property of the quadrature (5e-5 measured), not roundoff: do not tighten

onsite_remainder.pair_exchange.atom1.note: pair-exchange asymmetry, relative; a property of the quadrature (5e-5 measured), not roundoff: do not tighten
